ChurchStream is free software for **Seventh-day Adventist churches**: live streaming to YouTube and Facebook plus projection of hymns, Bible readings and announcements, from one simple control panel. It runs on Windows and Mac.

## Download

| Computer | Download |
|---|---|
| **Windows** laptop or PC | **[ChurchStream-win-x64.zip](https://github.com/driviere/churchStream/releases/download/v0.3.1/ChurchStream-win-x64.zip)** |
| **Mac with an Apple chip** (M1–M4) | **[ChurchStream-mac-arm64.zip](https://github.com/driviere/churchStream/releases/download/v0.3.1/ChurchStream-mac-arm64.zip)** |
| **Mac with an Intel processor** | **[ChurchStream-mac-x64.zip](https://github.com/driviere/churchStream/releases/download/v0.3.1/ChurchStream-mac-x64.zip)** |

**Updating?** Copy the new files over your old ChurchStream folder; your **ChurchStream-data** folder (settings, songs, services) is kept. First time? See the install steps in the [README](https://github.com/driviere/churchStream#install-windows).

## New in 0.3.1 — a sharper stream at the same internet speed
- **Better picture quality** on every encoder (software, Intel, NVIDIA, AMD and Apple): the stream now uses quality-first settings (B-frames and look-ahead) instead of low-latency ones. YouTube and Facebook add several seconds of delay anyway, so nothing is lost. Same bitrate, same upload speed.
- **Sharper slide text at 1080p:** the slide picture is now drawn at the stream's own size instead of being stretched from 720p.
- **Safe fallback:** if a computer's graphics driver doesn't accept the new settings, ChurchStream automatically uses the previous ones.

**Measured** (VMAF picture-quality score, 0–100, same footage and bitrate):

| Test | Before | **0.3.1** | OBS default |
|---|---|---|---|
| People moving, 720p | 36.9 | **39.5** | 37.7 |
| Camera pan, 720p | 69.3 | **71.3** | 69.3 |
| People moving, 1080p | 35.0 | **38.1** | 36.4 |
| Lyric slide change, worst frame (720p) | 91.0 | **96.0** | 95.7 |
| Slide text on a 1080p stream | 82.9 | **96.4** | — |

With software encoding it takes about 10% more processor time, the same as OBS's defaults. Hardware encoders couldn't be measured on GitHub's machines; please do a short test stream on your own computer.

## Good to know
- Projecting or streaming hymns still under copyright needs your church's **CCLI** licence (and the Streaming Licence for online use).
- ChurchStream is an independent project, not an official product of the Seventh-day Adventist Church.
